test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The given sentence is divided into four parts. Select the option that contains an error.**

The Dutta company/ has not being making/ new school bags/ since the lockdown commenced.
solution:
Here, the erroneous answer is **"has not being making".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct form of the verb in this sentence should be "been" </s
